senses.gloss:
ध्मा €1 P. (धमति, ध्मात; Caus. ध्मापयति)
—1 To blow, breathe out, exhale.
—2 To blow (as a wind-instrument), produce sound by blowing; शङ्खं
 दध्मौ प्रतापवान् Bg. 1. 12, 18; R. 7. 63; Bk. 3. 34, 17. 7.
—3 To blow a fire, excite fire by blowing, excite sparks; को धमेच्छान्तं
 च पावकम् Mb.
—4 To manufacture by blowing.
—5 To cast, blow, or throw away.

ध्मात p. p. [ध्मा-क्त]
—1 Blown (as a wind-instrument). ध्माता गिरेर्धातवः Bh.
—2 Blown up or into, inflamed, blown, fanned, excited.
—3 Inflated, puffed, puffed up.
ध्मापनम् Inflating, swelling by blowing into.
ध्मापित a. Reduced to ashes, burnt to cinder.

ध्माङ्(ध्वाङ्)क्ष् €1 P. (ध्माङ्क्षति)
—1 To crow, or caw.
—2 To desire.
